commitResults.messageTitle: Level-0: Rename Duke to Aster and greet
Level-3: Add task status with Task class
Level-4: Add typed tasks with inheritance
Level-5: Handle input errors with exceptions
Level-7: Add task storage and file format
commitResults.messageBody:
Tasks are lost when Aster exits because they exist only in memory.

Add a plain-text format for every task type and preserve each task's
status and type-specific fields. Escape separators in user text so
saved tasks can be read back without changing their contents.

Ignore generated data so personal task lists are not committed.

commitResults.messageTitle: Level-7: Save and reload tasks on disk
commitResults.messageBody:
Aster keeps its task list only for the duration of one run.

Load saved tasks before accepting commands and save the list after each
successful change. Stop safely when existing data cannot be read so a
possibly recoverable file is not overwritten.

Level-7 is complete on its required development branch.

Merge it without fast-forwarding so the branch topology remains visible
for course verification.

commitResults.messageTitle: Level-8: Store deadlines and events as dates
commitResults.messageBody:
Deadline and event dates were kept as whatever text the user typed, so
Aster could not tell a real date from any other words and could not
show one in a friendlier form.

Hold them as LocalDate instead, accept them as yyyy-MM-dd, and show
them as MMM dd yyyy with an explicit English locale so the output does
not change with the machine. Text that is not a real date is now
refused, which also rules out impossible dates such as 2019-02-29.

Store dates in ISO form so the data file stays locale independent. A
stored date that cannot be read is treated like any other unreadable
record: Aster explains and stops without overwriting the file.

Level-8 is complete on its required development branch.

Merge it without fast-forwarding so the branch topology remains visible
for course verification.

commitResults.messageTitle: A-MoreOOP: Split Aster into focused classes
commitResults.messageBody:
Aster held the only Scanner, every println, the command switch, the
parsing helpers and the task list itself, so no single responsibility
had a clear home and the class had grown past 400 lines.

Move user interaction into Ui, command interpretation into Parser, and
the task collection into TaskList, beside the Storage class that was
already separate. Storage is reused unchanged, so persistence behavior
is untouched.

Give each action its own Command object, with the keyword enum renamed
to CommandType to free the name while keeping its role as the single
list of keywords. A command that changes the list requests a save
after the change has been applied and reported. Checks that refuse a
command run before anything is changed. Aster retains only the run
loop.

Task numbers are still resolved against the list at execution time, so
the existing checks keep their order and their messages.

No user-visible behavior changes: the same transcript produces the
same output and the same data file as before.

A-MoreOOP is complete on its development branch.

Merge it without fast-forwarding to preserve the completed branch
topology while keeping master at the verified implementation.
